title: AI-Powered Content Agency
analysis: Most immediately revenue-generating. Indian B2B companies spend ₹50K-₹2L/month on content marketing. With Qwen3.6-35B + existing pipeline, produce 50-100 articles/week at near-zero marginal cost. Serve 10-20 clients at ₹30K-1L/month.
key_strength: Highest revenue + fastest time to first dollar

title: Paid Newsletter on Zoro
analysis: Indian startup research is high-value niche. VC and founder market of 150K+ active founders. Paid newsletter at ₹2K-5K/month with 500-1K subscribers yields ₹10-50L/month.

title: AI Content Localization Engine
analysis: 90% of India's internet users are vernacular speakers. Creator economy exploding. Target 1K-3K creators at ₹3K-15K/month yields ₹30L-4.5Cr/month.

title: Local AI Legal Doc Reviewer
analysis: 15M SMEs and 1.2M freelancers need affordable contract review. AI at ₹500-2K/month targets mass market. DGX Spark enables on-premise fine-tuning with data privacy.

title: AI-Powered Exam Prep Engine
analysis: India's exam market is massive — 12-15M students for JEE/NEET/UPSC/CAT. Unacademy, PW, BYJU'S dominate. Revenue potential ₹25L-7.5Cr/month but highly competitive battleground.

title: Specialized Data/Report Selling
analysis: Structured datasets for VCs and analysts. Indian startup funding data is fragmented. Pricing ₹5K-20K/month. TAM: 500-2K VCs/analysts in India/SEA.

title: AI-Powered Competitive Intelligence
analysis: Monitor competitor websites, job postings, pricing, social signals. Market growing at 20% CAGR, $1.2B in 2023. Crayon raises $10M+ rounds. Pricing ₹3K-20K/month.

title: SaaS Wrapper — Startup Intelligence
analysis: Productized version of data selling with UI and real-time monitoring. Crunchbase/Tracxn/Anliest dominate. Setup HIGH — needs auth, dashboards, alerts.

title: AI Research Report Generator
analysis: 400 universities, 20K+ PhD students in India. Pricing ₹2K-8K/month. Tools like Elicit/Consensus exist but are English-focused. DGX Spark enables local privacy.

title: Fine-Tuning Service
analysis: Leverages DGX Spark's 128GB unified memory for on-premise fine-tuning. Indian SMEs data-hesitant. ₹50K-5L per project. ~20 clients/year yields ₹10L-100L.
